theorem smooth_at_iff_continuous_and_comp_immersion_smooth_at
    {M M' M'' : Type*}
    {E E' E'' : Type*}
    {H H' H'' : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace ℝ E']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace ℝ E'']
    (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    (I' : ModelWithCorners ℝ E' H')
    (I'' : ModelWithCorners ℝ E'' H'')
    [ChartedSpace H M] [SmoothManifoldWithCorners I M]
    [ChartedSpace H' M'] [SmoothManifoldWithCorners I' M']
    [ChartedSpace H'' M''] [SmoothManifoldWithCorners I'' M'']
    {f : M → M'} {g : M'' → M}
    (hg_smooth : Smooth I'' I g)
    (hg_immersion : ∀ y, Injective (mfderiv I'' I g y))
    {x : M} {x'' : M''} (hx : g x'' = x) :
    SmoothAt I I' f x ↔ ContinuousAt f x ∧ SmoothAt I'' I' (f ∘ g) x'' := sorry
